Why Haysville Homes Need Major Remodels

Recent events underscore this reality. In Haysville's housing stock, this often means reconfiguring floor plans, updating homes to handle the 33 inches of annual rainfall more effectively, or replacing systems compromised by those 37 freeze-thaw cycles each year.
